bugs.rootCause: The daemon resolves the claude credential on the async dispatch critical path via a SYNCHRONOUS macOS Keychain FFI with no timeout and no spawn_blocking: run_loop.rs:760 crate::claude_cred::keys_for_backend(dispatch.backend, secrets, &daemon_env) -> claude_cred::resolve() -> MacKeychainBackend::get() -> security_framework::passwords::get_generic_password(). When a credential IS stored in the Keychain (as it was after this cycle's remediation), reading it triggers the item's access-control confirmation dialog because the rebuilt daemon binary is not the binary that wrote the item; in a headless tmux/no-window-server context that dialog is un-dismissable, so the read blocks forever. The task is already status='running' (finalized to running at 12:03:37 before the read), and the cancel/timeout race only wraps provider_run (never reached), so nothing can fail the task -> wedged at running with zero log output, no claude.jsonl, no child claude process. Independent repro: `security find-generic-password -s ainb-hangar::global -a claude.oauth_token -g` exits 124 (hangs). This is machine Keychain-ACL state, not a hangar logic regression; the code even ships a first-class bypass (HANGAR_CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN env override, resolved before the Keychain in claude_cred::resolve) designed for exactly this unattended/headless case.
bugs.fixPlan: IMMEDIATE (env remediation, no PR, makes next cycle green): mint a long-lived token once with `claude setup-token`, capture the sk-ant-oat... value, and export HANGAR_CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<token> into the ENVIRONMENT of every cycle's daemon launch (the `ainb hangar daemon restart` under AINB_HANGAR_HOME). claude_cred::resolve prefers this env override over the Keychain, so keys_for_backend injects CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN into the claude child with ZERO Keychain access -> no dialog, dispatch proceeds, claude authenticates headlessly. Do NOT store the token into the Keychain for the loop (that is what created the wedge); if a wedging item already exists, clear it with the daemon's clear verb or `security delete-generic-password -s ainb-hangar::global -a claude.oauth_token` before the cycle. Verify the override took: daemon `hangar ... status` should show cred source 'env override'. RECOMMENDED code-hardening follow-up (separate small PR, not required for green, honors the code's own doctrine 'a credential lookup must never wedge dispatch'): wrap the Keychain read in claude_cred::keys_for_backend/resolve in tokio::task::spawn_blocking + a short tokio::time::timeout, treating timeout/error as CredSource::None so a blocked or slow Keychain fails the task fast instead of wedging it at running forever. Files: crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/claude_cred.rs (resolve/keys_for_backend), crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/run_loop.rs (~line 760 call site, make the cred lookup awaitable+bounded).

bugs.rootCause: Daemon dispatch wedges at status=running forever because the claude-credential keychain read runs synchronously and unbounded on the async runtime thread, with a ~29-min observability black hole. Confirmed: execution stalls between run_loop.rs:726 (last log 'board auto-move' 12:26:52.801Z) and the provider .spawn() at runner.rs:1397 — zero daemon children, no claude.log written, session_id/work_dir NULL, row frozen 'running' for the full 58-poll window. The only indefinitely-blocking synchronous external call in that span is run_loop.rs:760 keys_for_backend -> claude_cred::resolve -> MacKeychainBackend::get -> security_framework::get_generic_password (mac.rs:62). That legacy SecKeychain API presents a BLOCKING GUI auth prompt whenever the calling binary is absent from the keychain item's ACL trusted-app list. The e2e debug binary is rebuilt every cycle (signature changes -> ACL trust invalidated), and the token persists in the GLOBAL login keychain (service ainb-hangar::global, account claude.oauth_token) independent of AINB_HANGAR_HOME. The daemon is headless, so the prompt is never answered and the thread blocks indefinitely. Hypothesis, not yet mechanically proven: emit_checkpoint / materialise_skills / materialise_profile also sit in this span but are local DB/FS (ms-scale) and log a warn on failure (none appears), so they are ruled unlikely.
bugs.fixPlan: IMMEDIATE ENV UNBLOCK (also the confirm/falsify test for next cycle): (a) export HANGAR_CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the daemon's launch env for the harness — claude_cred.rs:134 short-circuits to the env-override fast path and never touches the keychain; if the zombie vanishes, keychain-block is confirmed. (b) Alternatively clear the stale global item once: `security delete-generic-password -s 'ainb-hangar::global' -a 'claude.oauth_token'`. CODE FIX (crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/run_loop.rs ~748-760): move the credential resolution off the async thread and bound it — wrap keys_for_backend in tokio::task::spawn_blocking (same pattern as run_loop.rs:456 cap_parent_inbox) guarded by tokio::time::timeout (e.g. 5s). On timeout or join error, log a clear warn ('keychain credential read timed out; dispatching without injected CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN') and proceed with an EMPTY cred_env so the run either succeeds (env-override / no-ACL path) or reaches claude and fails loudly+actionably (finalize_failure seam already handles that at runner.rs, converting to terminal FAILED) instead of freezing 'running' forever. OBSERVABILITY (same file): emit a tracing::info! immediately before and after credential resolution so the 29-min silent span is never blind again — the black hole is itself a defect. DEEPER ROOT FIX (crates/ainb-hangar-secrets/src/mac.rs:60 get): make the read non-interactive so a locked/untrusted item returns errSecInteractionNotAllowed (-25308, already mapped to SecretError::BackendLocked -> treated as absent by resolve) instead of a GUI prompt — replace get_generic_password with a SecItemCopyMatching query setting kSecUseAuthenticationUI=kSecUseAuthenticationUIFail (security-framework's item API); this prevents ANY dispatch from ever being wedgeable by a keychain dialog. The run_loop timeout+spawn_blocking is the primary, sufficient fix; the mac.rs change is the belt-and-braces follow-up.

bugs.rootCause: All three cycle-4 failures collapse to ONE cause: the daemon that ran cycle 4 was the STALE sidecar binary target/debug/ainb-hangar-daemon (mtime 12:44 BST = 11:44 UTC), which PREDATES PR435 (merged 13:28 UTC). Proof: `strings target/debug/ainb-hangar-daemon | grep 'keychain credential read timed out'` = 0 (fix string absent), while the fresh ainb binary (14:29 BST) contains it (=1). The task dispatched at 13:41 UTC ran the old daemon, whose OLD unbounded synchronous keychain read wedged the run loop at running right after board auto-move (daemon.2026-07-21 stops after the auto-move line: no 'resolving claude credential' entry, no child process, no spawn/exec error) -- the EXACT zombie-dispatch signature PR435 fixed. Why stale: workspace default-members = crates/ainb-core, so a bare `cargo build` builds only ainb, NOT the separate ainb-hangar-daemon bin crate; the loop's rebuild rebuilt ainb but left the daemon artifact at its cycle-1/2 build. Why it got picked despite the fresh ainb: resolve_daemon_launch() (crates/ainb-core/src/cli/hangar/mod.rs:3242) prefers a sibling ainb-hangar-daemon next to the running exe BEFORE self-exec of the fresh ainb, and the stale sibling exists. The version-skew guard cannot catch it (both binaries stamp CARGO_PKG_VERSION 1.15.0, so daemon_version_skew returns None). Downstream mapping: F3 (daemon dispatched, never spawned agent) = direct symptom; F2 (task 01KY2EJ9DF stuck running, empty branch/session, zero commits) = its DB shadow; F1 (V4 'Source: undefined'/'Previous branch: undefined' placeholders) = pure downstream, the Pattern-B driver had no V3 branch to hand over from because V3's run never produced one. This is NOT a bad fix re-occurring: PR435's code is sound, it simply never executed in cycle 4.
bugs.fixPlan: Harness/env remediation for the NEXT cycle (no code PR needed to unblock): the rebuild/restage step must rebuild the daemon binary, not just ainb. Do ONE of: (1) `cargo build -p ainb-hangar-daemon` (default-members skips it), or (2) `rm target/debug/ainb-hangar-daemon` so resolve_daemon_launch self-execs the fresh ainb, or (3) export AINB_HANGAR_DAEMON_BIN pointing at a freshly built daemon. Then GATE before any V0 dispatch: assert `strings target/debug/ainb-hangar-daemon | grep 'keychain credential read timed out'` is non-empty AND daemon-binary mtime >= ainb mtime; and `ainb hangar daemon restart` under the fresh cycle home before verifying. bugs.rootCause: Deeper cause that made the harness miss silent and could bite real cargo/dev users: resolve_daemon_launch() (crates/ainb-core/src/cli/hangar/mod.rs:3242) unconditionally prefers a sibling ainb-hangar-daemon over self-exec, even when that sibling is OLDER than the current ainb exe. And daemon_version_skew() (mod.rs:3213) compares only CARGO_PKG_VERSION, so a byte-stale daemon of the same version (e.g. any debug rebuild that does not bump the version string) is completely invisible to `ainb hangar daemon status` -- exactly what happened in cycle 4 (both 1.15.0). This is a different LAYER from PR435 (which fixed the hang itself); this fix prevents a stale daemon from being silently launched or from passing the skew check.
bugs.fixPlan: Own small PR off latest main. (a) In resolve_daemon_launch, when the sibling ainb-hangar-daemon exists but its mtime < std::env::current_exe() mtime, prefer self-exec (`ainb hangar daemon run`) -- or at minimum emit a loud staleness warning naming both mtimes. (b) Embed a build fingerprint (git short SHA or build timestamp via option_env!/vergen) alongside the version, write it to daemon.version at launch (mod.rs:3742), and compare THAT in daemon_version_skew instead of only CARGO_PKG_VERSION, so status flags a same-version byte-stale daemon. Behavioral tests: sibling mtime older than exe -> launch resolves to the self-exec fallback; skew check with equal version but differing fingerprint -> reports skew (red-before / green-after mutation spot-check).
